def {{fn_name}}(point, polygon):
    x, y = point
    inside = False
    n = len(polygon)
    j = n - 1
    for i in range(n):
        xi, yi = polygon[i]
        xj, yj = polygon[j]
        if ((yi > y) != (yj > y)) and (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi + 1e-12) + xi):
            inside = not inside
        j = i
    return inside
